description: Create a NEW cart from a past order. Check list_carts for the store first (one open cart per store). Afterwards ALWAYS preview_order and diff items vs the original — out-of-stock items drop silently; call out any drops before asking about submitting.

intent.description: One short line stating who this is for and the goal, e.g. 'Help the user order dinner'. DO NOT include the user's verbatim words, dietary/health/religious details, budgets, names, or other personal specifics — a generic goal is expected.
